title: If you hire me — Partner email intake → Close.io

persona.label: Director of Partner Operations
persona.name: Marcus Hale
persona.org: Business funding company (Upwork client — persona inferred from post)

beats.label: Marcus Hale
beats.say: Partners email us deal packages — facts in the body, in PDFs, or both. Every layout is different. That email is our source of truth.

beats.label: ArchE
beats.say: Gmail ingest, Claude extract, your GHL or Zoho bridge, Close dot I O enrich, Slack — with confidence gates before any write.

beats.label: Marcus Hale
beats.say: Low confidence or missing docs goes to human review. No silent bad rows in Close dot I O.

beats.label: B.J. Lewis
beats.say: Week one on your stack — same playbook, your CRM plugged in.

beats.label: ArchE
beats.say: First wire — inbox, extract, gates locked, then speed.

beats.label: Marcus Hale
beats.say: My team should not retype the same deal three times.

beats.label: ArchE
beats.say: Structured JSON per message. Nothing touches Close dot I O until the gate passes.

beats.label: Jenny
beats.say: Human gate — reviewer saves the call, taps Done. ArchE holds the write until then.

beats.label: ArchE
beats.say: Clean fields to your middleware — Close dot I O gets rename, docs, and sequence.

beats.label: Marcus Hale
beats.say: Reps hear it in Slack — not by refreshing Close dot I O.

beats.label: ArchE
beats.say: Done to partner-intake. Review lane for the rest.

beats.label: Marcus Hale
beats.say: What do we get after go-live so my team runs this without calling you daily?

beats.label: ArchE
beats.say: Training dashboard, trace replay, and an Arche consultant leave-behind. Twenty minutes to confirm Close dot I O naming — then one partner-email path live.
